slides.headline: Ask these 5 before you offer
slides.body: Five questions that save buyers nasty surprises after they sign. Save this for your next viewing.

slides.headline: What's included in the sale?
slides.body: Curtains, light fittings, the stove, the pool pump. Get it in writing in the offer.

slides.headline: Any defects you know of?
slides.body: Ask for the seller's disclosure of known defects. Then check it yourself at the viewing.

slides.headline: Are the plans approved?
slides.body: Extra rooms, a closed-in patio, a flatlet. Ask if every addition is on the approved plans.

slides.headline: What are the monthly costs?
slides.body: Rates and taxes, plus levies in an estate or complex. Ask for recent accounts.

slides.headline: Why is it on the market?
slides.body: And how long has it been listed? The answers tell you how much room there is to talk.

slides.headline: Take this to every viewing
slides.body: My free room-by-room checklist, so nothing slips past you.
